FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_ComeAgainToForge.en: Come again if there are other\nmoves to be forgotten.
FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_ComeAgainToForge.fr: Reviens me voir si tu veux que tes\nPOKéMON oublient des capacités.

FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_MonHasForgottenM.en: It worked to perfection!\p{STR_VAR_1} has forgotten\n{STR_VAR_2} completely.
FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_MonHasForgottenM.fr: Ça a marché à la perfection !\p{STR_VAR_1} a complètement oublié\n{STR_VAR_2}.

FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_MonsMoveShouldBe.fr: Hum ! {STR_VAR_2} de {STR_VAR_1} ? Cette\ncapacité doit être oubliée ?

FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_NoEggShouldKnowM.en: What?\nNo EGG should know any moves.
FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_NoEggShouldKnowM.fr: Quoi ? Les OEUFS ne connaissent pas\nde capacité.

FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_WouldYouLikeToFo.en: Uh…\nOh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER.\pI can make POKéMON forget their\nmoves.\pWould you like me to do that?
FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_WouldYouLikeToFo.fr: Hum… Ah, oui, je suis l'EFFACEUR DE\nCAPACITES.\pJe fais oublier leurs capacités aux\nPOKéMON.\pTu veux que je le fasse ?
